## Page 1
Harmony Fusion for Multimodal Learning
Hal Vague, Ivy Unclear
Example University
Abstract
We propose the Harmony Fusion module for multimodal learning. The module fuses information from different modalities and improves
accuracy on several benchmark tasks. Ablation experiments confirm that the module is helpful.
1 Method
Our fusion block combines features from the two branches and leads to better representations. Details are given in the
supplementary material.
